meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 git 操作时会先判断你要提交、改写历史还是查记录。提交时默认把一个改动拆成多个原子提交,并按仓库既有风格和语言写提交信息。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase” 等关键词,或要求查某段代码是谁、何时改的时触发。

say.text: 把这些改动提交,拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先检测仓库提交风格与语言,再拆分并输出计划

say.text: 把这个分支的提交 rebase 合并整理干净
say.note: 先看是否已推送,再决定改写策略

say.text: 找出这行代码是谁、什么时候加的
say.note: 进入历史搜索流程,定位引入的提交

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first detects whether you want to commit, rewrite history, or look up history. For commits it splits changes into multiple atomic commits by default, matching the repo's existing style and language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "commit" or "rebase", or ask who wrote a piece of code and when it changed.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as several atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects repo commit style and language, then prints a plan

say_en.text: Rebase and clean up this branch's commits
say_en.note: Checks if pushed before choosing a rewrite strategy

say_en.text: Find who added this line and when
say_en.note: Runs the history search to locate the introducing commit
